system.name: TechSinger
system.one_liner: A flow-matching singing voice synthesis system with controllable vocal techniques in five languages, plus a prompt-based technique predictor.

content.variant_note: overall architecture in (a), with two lettered sub-panels that open the flow-matching postnet (b) and the technique predictor (c); all three read bottom-up
content.argues: TechSinger conditions a flow-matching pitch predictor and a flow-matching mel postnet on technique information, and a prompt-driven technique predictor lets users set techniques in natural language.
content.subject: singing voice synthesis network: encoders, duration and pitch predictors, mel decoder, flow-matching postnet and a transformer technique predictor

summary: TechSinger is a flow-matching singing voice synthesis system whose vocal techniques can be set directly or predicted from a natural-language prompt. Figure 1 has three lettered panels, all read bottom to top. (a) wires coloured token strips for lyric, note, singer ID and technique through encoders, a duration predictor with a length regulator, a flow-matching pitch predictor and a mel decoder to a vector field estimator. (b) shows the postnet as a column: a Gaussian-noise image, an ODE solver box with its equation, and the mel-spectrogram on top. (c) opens the technique predictor: an x N transformer block with cross-attention to a frozen text encoder, a classifier, and a CE loss between two cell strips.
summary_zh: TechSinger 是基于流匹配的歌声合成系统，可直接指定或用自然语言提示预测演唱技巧。图分 (a)(b)(c) 三块、自下而上：总体结构、从高斯噪声经 ODE 求解器得到梅尔谱的后网络、带冻结文本编码器的技巧预测器。
notes: Which boxes are the paper's contributions is not marked in the figure; the flags follow the abstract and the paper text. The figure does not expand LR (length regulator, per the paper's wording about extending to frame level). The yellow singer-ID cell and the yellow prompt cell share a colour although they are different inputs.
